stationary_pairs_per_carrier.definition: internal register tier, limit of the committed runs when classes 1 and 5 are gone: (c2 + c4)/2 and c3/2 faces per carrier, c_k(inf) from c_k(s) = c_k(inf) + B exp(-r s) with r of classes 1 and 5, fitted per level (L6..L10, sweeps >= 120); error = standard error over the five levels (independent seeds). Level 10 at its stored end (300 sweeps): (2,4) 0.26756 +- 0.00010, (3,3) 0.04091 +- 0.00004 (block errors). On carriers whose classes decompose into conjugate pairs only: (2,4) 0.2543, (3,3) 0.0397 (limit x ratio at L10 end).
